Technology is advancing with a startling pace, and some people have trouble keeping up with the most modern aspects. The old-timer found that they actually enjoyed adapting to the newest thing, and it was only the teenager who found the whole processing too exhausting, and kind of gave up completely already. Who is up to date with modern times?
A. The teenager
B. The old-timer
C. Cannot answer
